notes.title: This game will be unpublished
notes.notes: [p]Dear players,[/p][p]the game will be unpublished this week.[/p][p]It was the first hardcore game we worked on, and it was fun and a great learning experience for us. [/p][p]However, the game didn't get much traction on Steam or on other stores. So, we made a decision to sell it to another developer to recoup some of our costs.[/p][p]They request that we unpublish the existing project. They will use the code and the assets to do something of their own with it, maybe on mobile.[/p][p]Hopefully, our future projects will be more successful.[/p][p]If you already have the game in your Steam library, it will remain there, and [b]you can still play it[/b].[/p][p]We're happy that many of you found the game enjoyable! [/p][p]Thank you for playing![/p][p][/p]
